headline: 200+ Agentic Skills for AI Agents - Antigravity
short_description: Discover the ultimate collection of 200+ high-performance agentic skills tailored for Claude Code, Antigravity, and Cursor. These battle-tested skills include official offerings from Anthropic and Vercel, ensuring top-notch performance for AI agents.
author: sickn33

sections.overview:
Antigravity Awesome Skills is a comprehensive directory of agentic skills designed for AI development platforms including Claude Code, Antigravity, and Cursor. The collection features 200+ battle-tested skills that have been validated for production use. It includes official offerings from leading organizations like Anthropic and Vercel, ensuring quality and reliability. The repository is actively maintained with regular updates and community contributions, making it a resource for developers building with AI agents.
Automate repetitive coding tasks to save time and reduce errors.
Enhance security auditing processes by integrating automated vulnerability scanning.
Implement advanced React patterns to improve application performance and maintainability.
Streamline development workflows by automating deployment and CI/CD processes.
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
Advanced skill - requires experience with AI agents
